pasta module

MATLAB-aligned, blockwise PaSTA entry point.

pasta.pasta.pasta(x, y, coord, *, M=None, M_scale=3, qd=0.7, nugget=True, kernel_scale=4.0, block_size=2000, n_workers=1, xparc=None, yparc=None, max_clusters=10, min_clusters=1, min_cluster_size=500, D=None, dim=None, random_state=None) → PaSTAFit[source]

Run memory-efficient PaSTA or PaSTA-NS.

The keyword interface and returned fields match matlab_PaSTA/pasta.m. D accepts a full matrix or a NumPy-order packed strict upper triangle.
